notes.title: Azzy Battles the Darkness is apart of Debut Festival and updated demo!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, as the title says, Azzy is apart of the this years Debut Festival, a festival dedicated to showcasing indie developers first games and along with the festival, I have just released an updated demo.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo has some level changes, new lines, animations, a new WIP character, some new SFX and a few other small details.[/p][p][/p][p]Before I go again, I just want to say a huge thank you to everyone who has played the demo, wishlisted, provided feedback in Azzy's offical discord and have shown support for this game, if you want to see more smaller progress for Azzy then be sure to checkout the Celtic Dragon Studio bluesky page, I will try and us this more to show bigger updates as well, and lastly just keep in mind that this is still a pre-alpha build and will contain bugs and unfinished content.

Thank you everyone, hope you find all the amazing games in the fest and enjoy the demo[/p][p][/p][p][/p]
